caption: Turning raw signals from the physical world into decisions people can act on. Search geminislabs.com

slides.screen: Data is useless until someone acts
slides.say: Raw data is useless. A GPS ping or a sensor reading means nothing until someone decides what to do with it.
That's the idea behind Geminis Labs, a tech lab in Mexico City. Understand, protect, act.
We take signals from GPS, cell towers, sensors and vehicles, process them in real time, and spot what's unusual.
Then it reaches a person as an alert, a map or a report. The AI supports judgment. It doesn't replace it.
Check it out at geminislabs dot com. Follow for more.
